create_msn_loss: create an MSNLoss instance with temperature and teacher_momentum parameters for self-supervised training
build_msn_loss_from_config: build an MSNLoss from an AttrDict configuration containing temperature and momentum fields
test_msn_loss_forward: test the MSNLoss forward method by passing student and teacher output tensors
save_msn_loss_state: save the MSNLoss state dictionary for checkpointing with FSDP or DDP teacher models
restore_msn_loss_state: restore the MSNLoss state from a checkpoint to resume training with the momentum teacher
